matmul_reproducible — DRIVE ozaki op

• Data kinds: matrix × matrix → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.matmul_reproducible(A, B, tol: 'float' = 1.1102230246251565e-16) (to call the implementation directly, import ozakimm; ozakimm.matmul_reproducible(A, B, tol: 'float' = 1.1102230246251565e-16); from the registry, opsdrive.get("matmul_reproducible"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Bitwise-reproducible A @ B with FP64 accuracy (ValueError if this cannot be guaranteed = fail-closed).

The Ozaki-I automatic selection of matmul_ozaki with on_insufficient="raise" fixed. The error per element is at most tol · (|A||B|)_ij + the rounding of the final assembly (a few ulp). Returns the same bits regardless of the order of the inner index (order of points) or the number of BLAS threads. Intended for point-cloud contractions such as 3×N @ N×3 or 6×N @ N×6 (for products with large outputs it is 15–83 times slower than DGEMM).
